# F28 & Co.

> F28 & Co. is an operations consulting firm in Atlanta, GA, founded and led by Fallon Scott, CPA (fallonscott.com). We build businesses that can grow beyond their founders.

F28 began in 2019 as F28 Agency, an operations and systems agency. Clients stayed for one project after another, so it grew into a consulting firm. F28 audits the whole business as one system: the client journey and the employee journey. Our team delivers operations work in-house. Vetted partners handle specialist execution such as tax, funding, legal, PR and paid ads.

## Delivered in-house
- Fractional COO leadership and operational assessments
- Process mapping, SOPs and process documentation
- AI and automation
- AI readiness and risk assessments, AI governance and controls, AI strategy and roadmapping, led by Fallon Scott, CPA, and an AI Governance & Risk Lead with 18 years in bank compliance and risk
- Custom platforms (apps, CRMs, ERPs, LMS): F28 leads operational architecture, product management and implementation; development partners handle engineering
- Hiring systems, org design, training and recruiting, including skilled offshore talent
- SEO, GEO and AI search visibility, marketing and sales strategy
- Exit readiness and owner-dependency reduction

## Through vetted partners
- Tax returns, accounting, bookkeeping, fractional CFO, R&D tax credits
- Growth capital and funding
- PR, paid ads and marketing execution
- Legal, risk and compliance
- Executive recruiting and search
- Business valuation, M&A and transaction advisory
- Brand and website design
- ISO/IEC 42001 and ISO/IEC 27001 implementation and certification readiness, cybersecurity
